notes: full_min_percent raised by the exercise_pdf/ full builder sweep (issue #676, Phase 1) — all 184 build_* functions across bbh/bbg/bba now exercised, taking exercise_pdf/ from ~20% to 94% coverage. unit_min_percent is unchanged: the sweep's tests are all @pytest.mark.integration, and CI's unit-mode run never has reportlab installed, so _all_builders() takes its no-import sentinel path there and contributes nothing to unit coverage — this must be measured in an environment matching CI's package list exactly (no reportlab), not whatever happens to be installed locally, or the baseline silently fails on the next real CI run. Update only via `scripts/check_coverage.py --update-baseline`, in the same PR that earns the increase — see docs/policies/test-coverage.md.
